High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready errata card for [[Fusion Generator Supply Tanks (Dark) (PC Errata 2018 E card)|Fusion Generator Supply Tanks (Dark) (PC Errata)]] (the card with its Players Committee errata text and the errata mark) (Premiere Limited, Dark Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Errata/Dark_E/Fusion Generator Supply Tanks _ E.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1EO3RAUJQfY3T6ezRZ75UkCFth6AX53Tf/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Fusion Generator Supply Tanks _ E.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,339,404 bytes, SHA-256 <code>449c7a14466ae198bc2ffe10fca11e1cef87ce27797ca8da06300afba801870c</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 46.0, 47.5, 74.0, 57.0 px); resized: no; no other change.

The regular face of this card on its article stays [[:File:Premiere-D-fusiongeneratorsupplytanks.gif]]; this file is shown there as the High-Res Scan.
